name: thin-film
title: Thin Film Orb
description: An orb's rim shimmers with soap-bubble iridescence on black.
useWhen: A soft, premium hero moment: an AI or product reveal, a glowing bubble, a calm focus point.
A dark frame that needs one luminous object.
avoidWhen: The whole surface should shimmer in rainbow foil: use holographic.
You need a flat, bright backdrop.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Diameter of the orb as a share of the shorter side of the frame.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Rim width
variables.description: How far the shimmer reaches in from the edge.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it if edges look soft.
